atlantic.title: Atlantic transfers and naval war
atlantic.copy:
Chapter III moves from Barbados to Virginia and then Falmouth. The river and plantation in Virginia are unnamed. The regional label is not an arrival point.

The later naval expedition calls at Halifax before the 1758 siege of Louisbourg. Louisbourg marks the campaign on this overview; it is not part of the first crossing to England.

These are selected places, not a continuous voyage track. The reading includes repeated crossings and many additional calls.

points.name: Barbados
points.note: Chapter III begins with those not sold in Barbados, including the narrator, being sent to Virginia. The dot locates Bridgetown, not a particular ship.
points.label: Barbados

points.name: Virginia region
points.note: Broad regional label only. The text names no river, plantation, or landing place. The label is not a location claim.
points.label: Virginia region

points.name: Falmouth
points.note: Named first arrival in England in the narrative. Town locator, not a known berth.
points.label: Falmouth

points.name: Louisbourg
points.note: 1758 siege near the harbour on Cape Breton Island. The locator represents the historic fortress vicinity, not a battle position.
points.label: Louisbourg

channel.title: Channel ports and Belle-Île
channel.copy:
Falmouth and Guernsey belong to the early English and Channel experiences in chapter III. Portsmouth and Spithead recur as naval departure and return places.

Chapter IV describes the 1761 expedition against Belle-Île and a return in 1762. Belle-Île is off Brittany, France; Guernsey is a different island in the Channel.

Markers locate towns, islands, or anchorages approximately. They do not identify particular houses, ships, or landing beaches.

points.name: Falmouth
points.note: Town locator on the south coast of Cornwall.
points.label: Falmouth

points.name: Guernsey
points.note: Island locator, not the house where he boarded with Pascal’s mate.
points.label: Guernsey

points.name: Portsmouth / Spithead
points.note: Approximate Spithead anchorage off Portsmouth. The text distinguishes the roadstead from the town.
points.label: Portsmouth / Spithead

points.name: Belle-Île
points.note: Island locator for the 1761 expedition and 1762 return. No landing beach is asserted.
points.label: Belle-Île

mediterranean.title: The Mediterranean and the Portuguese coast
mediterranean.copy:
In chapter IV, the fleet reaches Gibraltar, takes on water at Barcelona, and cruises off Toulon. Gibraltar connects the Mediterranean with the Atlantic.

The action of August 1759 leads onto the Portuguese coast. The text’s “Cape Logas” belongs to the episode known as the Battle of Lagos. This is Portugal, not Lagos in Nigeria.

The Lagos marker locates the coastal town for orientation. It is not an exact battle or shipwreck position.

points.name: Gibraltar
points.note: Harbour and Mediterranean entrance. The chapter includes repeated visits.
points.label: Gibraltar

points.name: Barcelona
points.note: City locator; the fleet takes on fresh water in the bay.
points.label: Barcelona

points.name: Toulon
points.note: Port locator; the fleet cruises off the French naval base.
points.label: Toulon

points.name: Lagos coast
points.note: Portuguese coastal context for the 1759 battle. No exact engagement or wreck site is plotted.
points.label: Lagos coast

thames.title: Westminster, Deptford, and the lower Thames
thames.copy:
Westminster: chapter IV places baptism at St Margaret’s and a near-drowning by Westminster Bridge. The marker locates the church-and-bridge area.

Deptford: the narrator arrives on 10 December 1762. Pascal then forces him into a boat and takes him downstream.

Below Gravesend: he is sold aboard the Charming Sally, bound for the West Indies. The town is shown as a reference; the ship’s anchorage is not known.

The river line is generalized modern geography. It shows the connection between these places, not a reconstructed 1762 shoreline or exact boat track.

points.name: Westminster
points.note: St Margaret’s church vicinity. Westminster Bridge is nearby to the northeast.
points.label: Westminster

points.name: Deptford
points.note: District locator near the former royal dockyard. No exact mooring or point of seizure is identified.
points.label: Deptford

points.name: Gravesend
points.note: Town locator. The sale occurs aboard a ship a little downstream of Gravesend, not at this dot.
points.label: Gravesend
